meta.headlineFinding: No per-zone damage multiplier table (head/chest/legs xN) is published ANYWHERE public for ANY enemy — not in official patch notes, either wiki, Steam guides/reviews, Reddit, or press. Zone damage is documented only qualitatively (weak spots, invulnerable bodies, armor).

globalMechanics.name: First strike
globalMechanics.value: 3x damage on the first hit against an unaware enemy (OFFICIAL, Tomb Extraction, 21 Sep 2026). Situational, NOT a body zone.

globalMechanics.name: Criticals (weapon perk)
globalMechanics.value: 20-32% chance for 300% damage (COMMUNITY wiki). Crits are perk-based, not zone-based, per all documentation.

globalMechanics.name: Spectral Echo (weapon perk)
globalMechanics.value: Delayed echo at double damage (OFFICIAL, Sep 2026).

globalMechanics.name: Damage numbers UI
globalMechanics.value: Since 21 Sep 2026 the game itself displays hit multipliers in a toggleable damage-numbers UI (OFFICIAL) — the only authoritative way to read zone multipliers is in-game measurement; no player has published measurements yet.

globalMechanics.name: Arms are a zone
globalMechanics.value: Hitting a frozen enemy's weapon applies damage like hitting its arm (OFFICIAL, May 2024).

globalMechanics.name: Toughness tiers
globalMechanics.value: Light/Medium/Heavy/Elite/Legendary scale health, attack power and damage resistance (community) — resistance values never published.

globalMechanics.name: Armor
globalMechanics.value: Armored enemies exist across types; NO armor damage-reduction % is published for any enemy.

meta.ownerUpdate2026_10_20: Owner corrections: 'Megamage' is his placeholder joke — the enemy is the Ubermage; ubermage figures head x3 / torso x2 / legs x3 (legs corrected from x1). layerSpec.fallback: When no images are supplied for an enemy, the stage renders a generic CSS/SVG dummy figure using the same layer structure, with zones from hitboxZones.
layerSpec.imageWorkflow: Research collects in-game mob images -> owner separates mob from background -> separated files are dropped into the slots above (paths/URLs) with no code changes.

layerSpec.purpose: Dummy hitbox models are rendered as separated 2D layers for a high-quality depth (2.5D parallax) effect at very low render cost — transforms only, no 3D engine, no per-frame repaint.

devTeamDataRequests.framing: The recipient dev team already possesses the game's real statistics (owner, 2026-10-20). Our job is placeholders + clear questions. Owner-observed figures in this file are explicitly NOT certain — treat every one as 'confirm or replace'. A null multiplier means the input slot is open.
generalQuestions: For each enemy: what is the definitive hit zone list? (zones we guessed may not exist; zones we missed may)
For each zone: what is the exact damage multiplier? (including 0 / no-damage zones and instant-kill zones)
Can zones be removed or disabled (e.g. zombie arms), and what are the exact mechanics/conditions?
Does armor reduce damage per zone, and by how much? Do any weapons pierce it?
How do toughness tiers (Light/Medium/Heavy/Elite/Legendary) scale zone damage or resistance?
Do multipliers differ by difficulty tier, realm, or co-op player count?
